sources.title: Muse Glimmer | Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: muse-glimmer-30b Model by Meta | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a multimodal reasoning model accepting text and images, with native tool-calling and separate reasoning output.

sources.title: Meta Open Sources Muse Glimmer: A 30B Agentic AI Model
sources.snippet: Meta's 30B-parameter Muse Glimmer runs offline on a single consumer GPU to execute local coding, function calling, and autonomous agent workflows.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is Meta's compact agentic model for running long-horizon AI workflows locally. It combines multi-step reasoning, reliable tool calling, failure recovery, and multilingual support with image understanding through a dedicated perception encoder. The official 17GB K-quant build is designed for a 24GB memory envelope.
